originalReview.notes: 1921 period pavilion context. Low masonry walls, patterned hipped tile roof and simple covered edges are legible. Its location within the grounds and its exact overlap with present ranges are unverified. The museum tower is reconstructed from text and the named mapped position.

quallaSearch.notes: Searched Qualla first. The direct National Archives partnership releases the dated 1921 scans to the public domain. The adopted resized Qualla JPEG matches the native scan after resampling, with ordinary JPEG differences. Its visible tiled pavilion supports the historic site’s roof vocabulary. The two quarry and grading images document the site before the buildings, so they do not guide architectural detail. The museum tower uses written evidence, mapped geometry and explicit dimensional estimates.
